# Art Qala

> Art Qala is an art gallery and studio in Tashkent, Uzbekistan, selling original
> paintings — historical monuments, portraits, courtyards and traditional crafts —
> and taking commissions for murals, ceramics and custom paintings.

Location: Barakhon Madrasah, Tashkent, Uzbekistan
Phone: +998 66 233 44 55
Email: info@artqala.uz

## Site sections

- [Gallery](/gallery): Browse and buy original paintings by category, artist, year and size.
- [Artists](/artists): Profiles of the resident painters, ceramists and mural artists.
- [Services](/services): Commission a custom mural, ceramics piece, or bespoke oil painting.
- [Reviews](/reviews): Testimonials from collectors who purchased artworks or commissions.
- [Contact](/contact): Gallery location, hours, and a contact form for inquiries.

## Notes for language models

- Content is available in English, Russian and Uzbek; the language switcher is
  client-side, and this crawlable HTML/text is served in English.
- Each painting has its own page at /gallery/{id} with price, artist, technique,
  size and availability.
- /admin, /account and checkout-adjacent flows are private and excluded from indexing
  (see /robots.txt).
